transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before I sign off on the annex room assignments and controls, I need to hear from facilities and signal. Please report any room, infrastructure, or opening requirements you have for the East and West rooms. Both can be made ready tomorrow morning, and we'll have an equipment-issue desk and a protected medical-records desk to place. What do you need from your end?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a floor-load concern before we assign rooms. The equipment-issue desk's steel storage cabinet weighs 1,100 kilograms when stocked. I verified this morning that East Room is rated for 800 kilograms and West Room is rated for 1,500 kilograms. The equipment-issue desk cannot safely go in East Room — it would exceed the floor rating by 300 kilograms. West Room can handle it. I have not yet added the floor-load note to the relocation worksheet, but the measurements are confirmed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a network connectivity requirement for the protected medical-records desk. That desk can only connect to the required isolated network through the fiber patch panel located in the East Room. My signal technician is already booked to certify that connection tomorrow from 0900 to 1000 — I received the booking confirmation this morning. However, this certification is not yet on the annex opening checklist, so we need to add it. This means the protected medical-records desk needs to go in East Room, which also has implications given Maj. Alvarez's floor-load concern for the equipment-issue desk.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Add the floor-load note to the relocation worksheet documenting that East Room is rated for 800 kg and West Room for 1,500 kg, and that the equipment-issue desk's steel storage cabinet weighs 1,100 kg stocked.
Add the fiber patch panel network certification to the annex opening checklist, scheduled tomorrow 0900-1000.
